Dan (HR Ops): Hiring ops heads: scan active reqs for "parental" and "relocation" and tag me if numbers need updating. I'll hold new postings until JDs are aligned.

AckBot: Auto-update: 9/42 managers confirmed, 1 session full, recording link will be posted after live sessions.
